s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic pelvic pain
salient_findings: Hypoechoic mass measuring approximately 6.2 cm in diameter with an irregular border over the right adnexa
Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
key_facts: 36-year-old woman
Gravida 2, para 2
Previously diagnosed with presumed progressive uterine fibroids 6 months earlier
Presenting with right lower pelvic pain
Transabdominal sonography showed a hypoechoic mass
Computed tomography showed a moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor
Laparoscopic findings revealed a round and smooth surface mass
Pathological examination revealed a benign lesion
Frozen section revealed a benign lesion
Final pathology showed spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells
Immunohistochemistry was positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors

shortlist.label: Adenofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign lesion with spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells, positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors

shortlist.label: Ovarian fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypoechoic mass and moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor, consistent with a benign ovarian tumor

shortlist.label: Sclerosing stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Benign lesion with loose fibromyxoid stroma and positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors

shortlist.label: Thecoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign lesion with spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells, positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors

shortlist.label: Adnexal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube, consistent with a benign adnexal tumor

raw.rationale: The final pathology showed spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells, and immunohistochemistry was positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors, which are characteristic of thecomas

rejected.label: Adenofibroma
rejected.why: Lack of glandular elements in the pathological examination

rejected.label: Ovarian fibroma
rejected.why: The tumor was described as arising from the isthmus of the right tube, not the ovary

rejected.label: Sclerosing stromal tumor
rejected.why: The pathological examination did not show the characteristic pseudolobular pattern and sclerotic bands of sclerosing stromal tumors

rejected.label: Adnexal tumor
rejected.why: Too broad of a term, as thecomas are a specific type of adnexal tumor
